Fire off fireworks for a bounty of Treasure Hunter rewards!

Use a Treasure Hunter key to fire off a selection of different fireworks to win rewards with a selection of different modifiers!
Keys can be purchased or earned through completing quests and playing the game. You will also be given free daily keys every day!

Prismania has been upgraded! Each day celebrates a different set of skills that have boosted XP gains in both lamps and stars! Whether you are looking for a boost in your Artisan Skills, or perhaps your Combat needs a helping hand - choose the day which boosts that particular set of skills and earn an additional 10% experience on top of the 50% Prismania already has to offer! Be sure to check back on the final day, which has a bumper selection of skills! <col=FFFFFF>Invention benefits from a 50% XP increase on the normal days and a 60% XP increase on the last day.</col>

Karima is back! Open chests this weekend to collect stars and lamps. When using them, you'll have a chance of getting a visit from Karima - the wish granting genie.

She'll offer you a variety of Blessings - you can ask her for gold, or Bonus XP in either a specific skill, or one at random which will grant you more Bonus XP! Keep rubbing lamps or wishing on your stars, because Karima has no limit, but hurry - when she appears she will only stick around for 4 minutes before disappearing. Genie's are busy you know!

The time is here again! Look to the sky to find that celestial activity has been on the increase, collect Meteorites and Space Dust giving you an increased 33% XP or Bonus XP respectively, if you use these space warped items on one of your 5 lowest skills, you'll get an increased 100% extra bonus XP instead!

The Bonus Chest is a new chest that allows you to see the prize it contains before you claim it; but not only that, open it and get double or triple the normal prize! Open chests on Treasure Hunter to charge the bar and make the Bonus Chest appear.
Get your hands on new Rare Items
Pulse cores grant double XP while equipped in the pocket slot in any skill. Once out of charges it will explode and grant a stackable XP bonus (up to 10%) and a random buff to other people nearby.

Pulse Cores have made a comeback - get your hands on these powerful cores that grant 150% bonus XP while active. On top of that, you'll pulse out an anima power that empowers everyone beside you as well! Each time a core pulses, you'll give those around you a 2% XP boost, which stacks up to 10%! Use them in populated skilling areas to ensure everyone gets the most out of their gains!

Win toolboxes that can be used to create prototype dwarven tools. These allow you to create chainsaws, drills or fish hoovers which either grant double XP and no resources or double resources and no XP. These degrade after 100 uses but can be repaired with additional tools.

The newest addition to the protean range. Burn them for Firemaking XP, fletch them for Woodcutting XP, or fletch and burn them for Firemaking and Woodcutting XP at the same time. You can also win protean packs so stock up today on all your protean materials!

The Spring Cleaner is back - and this time it comes with upgrades! Win the Spring Cleaner and then use it in battle or add springs to it to instantly upgrade it. As it upgrades it becomes more efficient and unlocks new abilities, including being able to use it from the bank or pocket slot.

Wonderbar is back with guaranteed purple prizes! Open chests to gain charges and activate the wonderbar for guaranteed prizes from that category or rarer. Make sure to watch the purple gem - fill it to 100% and press it to guarantee your next prize is a purple. In this Wonderbar, you even have chances at extra bonuses - from getting extra charges when opening a chest and chances at only using half charges on the bar or the purple gem when claiming! What are you waiting for? Get out there and get lucky!

Collect Astromancer Credits from both Treasure Hunter and certain in-game activities! Clicking on the credits opens up your Astromancer Progress, where you can give credits to each of the four factions, earning cosmetic rewards and pets along the way. Once you've completed each faction you'll be rewarded with the Astromancer Outfit, which gives you one small meteor each day, with a chance for this to be upgraded to a large meteor! Use further credits to charge the outfit up while you can for a grand total of 55 days!

It's time to become the ultimate Dragon Slayer! This weekend, pick up brand new Metallic Dragon Trinkets from Treasure Hunter, allowing you to unleash your fury on metallic dragons too. All the benefits from Dragon Trinkets still apply - chances to instakill dragons, note items on dropping and more - and you can even chose which of these benefits activate now, so you won't waste trinkets on benefits you don't want to activate! Both Dragon Trinkets and Metallic Dragon Trinkets can be won from Treasure Hunter, but you can convert them into each other should you prefer a different type - go show those scaled fiends who's boss!
Head addons for Cooking, Prayer, Farming and Herblore that improve your skilling headgear with daily teleports and free items, plus a chance to get extra materials.
Open mystery boxes for a chance to win exciting new tradeable rare items. For each box you open you gain a big mystery box that gives you a chance to win a fantastic star prize.

More Skill Stations have arrived! Check out the brand new additions, including Portable Fletcher, Portable Crafter and the Portable Brazier. Each of these skill stations will allow you to partake in the majority of each skills activities, and provide you with an extra 10% of XP while using them as well as a variety of additional, skill specific benefits, so get your hands on them while you can!

Brand new Slayer Masks have found their way to the Treasure Hunter Chests! Grab all new masks, including masks for Airuts, Aquanites, Automatons, Black Demons, Dagannoths (which includes the Kings) and Ganodermic Creatures. Each mask gives you the usual benefits, such as guaranteed Slayer tasks once every three days, teleports directly to areas housing your chosen masks creatures and a plethora of extras!

The ultimate ninja training, take on the challenge of the Death Lotus to complete a variety of tasks and challenges. Once you have completed a row or column, you will be rewarded with outfit pieces, cash bags or experience. Complete the entire scroll and you will earn the ability to prestige, unlocking Death Lotus themed weapons and outfit recolours. Earn Shurikens from Treasure Hunter to instantly finish tasks, and be sure to be on the lookout for the Ninja Master roaming Gielinor.

Something to really warm your heart, this week you will be able to collect and use Hearts of Fire, giving you more control than you've ever had over your Treasure Hunter prizes.

Once you've heated it up enough to use, the Heart of Fire will allow you to select exactly what your next prize will be. The rarer the prize the more Hearts of Fire it will cost and it will trigger a cooldown before you can use them again.

Use your Hearts of Ice to freeze out broader categories, then use your Heart of Fire to really home in on a specific prize, including the all new light and dark themed armour sets!

It's time for a festival! Win Novtumber Festival seeds on Treasure Hunter which can be planted anywhere and will quickly reach full growth. Once grown, pick the produce and offer it to the Gods for Prayer XP or return it to the earth for Farming XP.

You will also receive magic beans during the festival - one for every 200 Farming XP gained and they can be traded in to Martin the Master Gardener for various Farming seeds.

For those who like to delve into dungeons we have Dungeoneering Wildcards. Consume one while you are in Daemonheim to give you 50% extra experience and 50% extra tokens for the floor that you are on. These cards do not stack and cannot be used on the same floor as personal Gorajo cards.
Treasure Hunter lamps and stars used on Dungeoneering will give you 25% extra XP during the promotion.

Starlight Ore is falling onto Gielinor once again! Ore can be found while mining and also on Treasure Hunter - the ore is now tougher, and can be used to create exclusive Starfire Armour sets - one mage set, one melee and one ranged.

You can then upgrade these armour pieces with Starborn Diamonds to Starfury Armour and gain mining experience, improved appearance and additional skilling bonuses at Seren Stones.

A corrupting force has taken hold of the Treasure Hunter chests and offers brand new prizes to be won! Open chests with keys or skill and kill to deliver lost souls to the chests and increase their power - as you pass the milestones you will unlock additional rewards that can be won.

Within the chests are dark stars and lamps that grant extra XP, a number of scrimshaws that will aid you in combat and the helm of corruption that will change appearance as you build a kill streak.

The latest in our collection of Seasonal offerings - this adorable sprout adapts to whatever the season may be! Collect Branches, Blossoms, Seeds and Leaves in order to create four separate pets, then combine those pets to create your improved, changing Pet of Seasons. You can win these items from Treasure Hunter, or through skilling. Seeds can be collected through Herblore, Blossoms through Woodcutting, Leaves from Farming and Branches from Firemaking!

Rumours of the king's legendary sword have surfaced! Head to Falador and work together with other heroes of Gielinor to locate, uproot and claim this powerful sword. Work on both personal and group progress to make the sword as powerful as it can be when you discover it. Use standard tools to help progress the bar, and win golden tools from Treasure Hunter, which give you massively increased XP and progress!

A weekend of horrific prizes and scary winnables! Earn Candy Corn from Treasure Hunter as well as various in-game activities such as Daily Challenges and skilling or killing, then exchange them for some gruesome prizes, including a Vampiric Outfit, a Pumpkincrow pet, Bat Necklace and more!

We're loading up with various Firemaking themed items for more XP gains in Firemaking, Agility, Summoning and Construction. Members can get their hands on Treasure Hunter's fire poi, fire breathing solution, fire stone and firewood to ignite the most XP during this event.

These Divine simulacrum outfits are perfect for that advanced training. When you complete one of the 3 base sets, you'll have a chance to gain 2 memories instead of 1, a chance of getting double chronicles on a gather and a teleport to a Chronicle hand in point.
Combine the 3 base sets for the Elder Divination outfit, giving you a higher chance of the previous sets, as well as a chance of getting five times the energy and gain another 3 teleports to specific wisp colonies!

Have you had your eye on one of those rare items? Well this is your weekend! For five days, you'll be able to get your hands on more Rare Tokens in order to spend them in our Rare Store! Additionally, everything in the Rare store is 10% off! So grab your tokens and claim your rare items!

Grab these new dummies to help you train your more nefarious skills.
Hone your pickpocketing skills with the thieving dummy, which looks like everyone's favourite merchant.
Alternatively practice your finishing Slayer moves in safety with our slayer dummy. Get out all of your fancy moves because this one doesn't bite back.

It's Christmas come early! For 24 days you'll be able to take part in previous promotions! Visit Treasure Hunter each day to find out what prizes are available to win, from skill outfits to Meteor Storm, from Dragon Trinkets to Protean Hides, from Silverhawk Feathers to Prismania, make sure you check in and take part in the promotions you want to! On top of that, open your advent calendar every day for a free gift relating to that day's promotion!

Win these Loot Piñatas from Treasure Hunter, hang them up and go crazy in order to win awesome prizes - catch everything that comes out and you can get anything from stat boosting sweets to all new rares, like the Piñata plushie, sombrero and luchador mask tokens. You are not limited to your own Piñata though! Feel free to take a swing at a friend's piñata too, and see what you can bag.

From the depths of The Nexus, collect the all new Grotesque inspired outfit including cape and wings now on Treasure Hunter! Killing monsters will occasionally award you with Grotesque Souls, which are also available from Treasure Hunter chests - combine these souls to create pieces of the Grotesque Armour and collect the set. But it doesn't stop there - continue to kill monsters with the armour and unlock more grotesque versions of the set, as it mutates into an even more gruesome outfit.

PLEASE NOTE: Although a majority of monsters will give souls and mutate your armour further, several unique monsters such as the Wights found in Rise of the Six will not reward the player.

Take on the challenge of <col=1589FF>Zodiac training</col> to complete a variety of tasks and challenges. Once you have completed a row or column, you will be rewarded with <col=1589FF>monkey trinkets</col>, <col=FFFFFF>cash bags</col> or <col=FFFFFF>experience</col>. Complete the entire scroll and you will earn the ability to prestige, unlocking <col=1589FF>Dragon hats</col> and recolours. Win <col=FFFFFF>Envelopes</col> on Treasure Hunter to instantly finish tasks, and be sure to be on the lookout for the Wounded Snake Icxan roaming Gielinor.

Love is in the air! This year collect Valentine's Petals - all of which can be used to purchase a wide variety of rewards! Earn these petals by opening Treasure Hunter chests, skilling, combat and even handing in Daily challenges. Use this currency to then collect the huge range of rewards on offer, including new items such as the Masquerade outfit, Helps the goblin butler follower pet, new emotes and the Sceptre of Enchantment - a staff that grants you and all nearby players an XP and Health buff! You can also spend your currency to collect rewards from previous Valentine's promotions.

There's an evil lurking in the treasure chamber... Some of the chests have been enchanted by an evil curse and morphed into mimics. Now attacking everything in sight, it's up to you to enter the dungeon and put a stop to it. Throughout the weekend, defeat the Giant Mimic boss and you'll have a chance of winning new amazing loot, such as the all new Mimic plushie. The Mimic comes in 4 difficulties, and the harder it is, the better prizes it'll drop. Loot the boss up to 5 times each day, and earn tokens on Treasure Hunter for further attempts!

Slaying Vampyres is the name of the game - and with the Vampyre Slayer outfit, you'll really reap the benefits. Throughout the promotion opening Treasure Hunter chests, completing daily challenges, Temple Trekking, or even just regular skilling and killing will earn you Vampyre Fangs - and earn double the amount when these activities are completed in Morytania! Use these fangs to create Vampyre Hunter gear, that gives you a thrilling number of bonuses, including increased damage to Vampyres, one Barrows Chest re-roll per run and more.

Open chests or take part in various Fletching and Agility activities this weekend in order to get your hands on all new Lightweight Feathers! Once you earn enough, you will be able to turn these feathers into pieces of the new Fletching or Agility skill outfits. Each piece gives you a 1% XP boost, with an extra 1% if you wear all 5 pieces. Overflowing with feathers? You can also give them to Drill Sargeant Hartman or Alison Elmshaper for either Agility or Fletching medium XP lamps!

The time has come to prepare for the fight of your life. The Heart of Gielinor is upon us; it is imperative we're ready! Help Ajjat to train adventurers each day for Combat XP, whilst building statues outside the entrance to the dungeon to enhance your skills in Construction and more. Work as a community to complete the necessary tasks and unlock rewards together, including the Energised Arm Cannon. Ran out of tools for the job? Earn more through opening Treasure Hunter chests during the event, or speak to Ajjat to buy more with Loyalty Points!

Unlock chests whilst moving around the Guthixian themed butterfly to unlock each node (each move uses 1 key). Unlock all nodes and you can claim your prestige prize! The more you prestige the better your prestige prizes get, also the wings will be filled with increasingly better prizes! Prizes include butterfly jars containing Guthix butterflies and an Aurelian cape!

It's time to shake things up a little... Introducing all new Rares to the Rare Shop! There are a limited number of discounted new rares to get your hands on, including Ban Hammers, Magician's Wands, Potion Hats and more. Get them before they return to their normal price, and also be sure to grab any 'Limited Rares' before they disappear from the store. Low on Rare Tokens? Be sure to open chests this weekend - there's an increased chance of them dropping!

Something's not right within Gielinor... A huge rift to the Shadow Realm has appeared near Draynor, with smaller rifts spawning around the world. Work together with other adventurers to help close these rifts, and put a stop to the mysterious Janus, who appears to be connected to them. Use your Runecrafting and Summoning skills to close the rifts and avoid the Shadow Realm seeping into our own. Speak to the ZMI apprentice near the main rift to learn how you can help, as well as collect rewards, including two new sets of Runecrafting and Summoning inspired wings.

These camouflage outfits are perfect for that advanced training. When you complete one of the 3 base sets, you'll have increased chances to avoid being stunned when pickpocketing, increased chance of double pickpocketing, boosts within Pyramid Plunder and teleport to thieving locations.
Combine the 3 base sets for the Master Camouflage outfit, giving you a higher chance of avoiding stuns while pickpocketing, increased chance of double pickpocketing, greater chance of Seren symbol piece drops, autopickpocket (to a max of 10 in a row), and more teleports to thieving locations.
The newest addition to the protean range. Release the protean memories to convert them into experience. You can also win protean packs so stock up today on all your protean materials!

Lava lanterns are available now, and redeeming them gives you a mix of both direct and bonus XP! Simply pick a skill to put XP into, like you usually would, and get a combination of both direct XP and the same amount of bonus XP on top! Perfect for a quick top up, and help during your next gains session.

This weekend on Treasure Hunter, all lamps and stars have been replaced with bright versions! These will give a boosted amount of XP when used, ranging from 50% to 100%! Watch as with each chest you open, the temperature gauge on Treasure Hunter rises, giving more and more XP with each level unlocked!

The time has come to prepare for a voyage into the Arc. Locate Umi next to the Port Sarim Ports Portal to help build a boat and prepare provisions for the trip, as well as hone your Slayer skills to fend off pirates. Work as a community to complete the necessary tasks and unlock rewards together, including the Skilling Backpack. Ran out of tools for the job? Earn more through opening Treasure Hunter chests during the event, or speak to Umi to buy more with Loyalty Points!

It's time to fashion the power of seasons into your armour itself! Collect the various resources from either Treasure Hunter or through skilling to forge them into the Armour of Seasons - an outfit woven from nature itself. Charred Branches can be gained from Firemaking, Lush Blossoms can be obtained from Woodcutting, Flourishing Seeds can be received from performing Herblore tasks and Fallen Leaves can be gained from Farming! Combine these pieces into their various outfits and combine those four outfits into the full Armour of Seasons!

Grab these new dummies to help you train your more intricate skills.
Hone your agility skills with the agility dummy.
Alternatively practice setting your traps in safety with our hunting dummy.

It's time to complete those sets! Win pieces of Elite Skill outfits! You'll be able to complete and collect the following: Master Construction, Gorajan Trailblazer, Sentinel Woodcutting, Elite Trapper and Camouflage sets.

Help Reyna organise another Beach Party, open mystery boxes, and be in for a chance to win a whole range of new fruit parasols! If you give Reyna all the sand she asks for, you'll be rewarded with a mystery box each day and a big mystery box at the end that gives you even more chances to win some awesome prizes! You can also win some cocktail shakers which give herblore and cooking XP!

Gems, gems, gems! Every time you open a chest during this promotion, the gem type will be saved in the slots to the side - line up 5 gem colours and you'll be able to claim an extra prize! The rarer the gems in the slots, the better the prize will be, so use Hearts of Ice to lock in up to two rare gems that might appear before they're knocked out by more common colours. You will also be able to get hold of all the previous Gemerator Rares, as well as the all new Gem Rucksack!
Attack of the Zombie Sprouts, October 2016

Near Draynor Manor and around the world, the living and the not-so-living Sprouts are breaking free from their roots and fighting one another. Use your Farming and Herblore skills to help grow or corrupt the sprouts and determine the outcome of this battle. Speak to Lady Niya or her evil twin sister near Draynor to learn more, as well as collect rewards, including two sets of Farming and Herblore inspired wings as well as a Zombie sprout pet to call your own.

Celebrate summer this weekend and jump into the Summer Beach Party! Loot pinatas are back on Treasure Hunter with some brand new, beach themed cosmetics within them for this weekend only. Also, get your hands on some Beach Booster tokens! These handy little things will increase the amount of XP you receive whilst performing actions on the beach, and will stop your temperature from increasing!

Experience the power of clairvoyance on Treasure Hunter! The rarities and prizes in chests can be revealed! Then it's down to you - do you play it safe and open a chest with a prize or rarity that you know? Or take a chance on the unknown?

These Gorajan Trailblazer outfits are perfect for that advanced training. When you complete one of the 4 base sets, you'll have the following Dungeoneering benefits:
*5% XP boost
*5% base floor XP boost
*5% reduced depletion of skilling nodes
*Ice walking boots to stop sliding
*Chance of not using up a lockmelter
Sinkholes:
*3 additional sinkhole teleports a day
Complete the high tier outfit by combining all of the low tier pieces, to get the following benefits:
*7% XP boost
*7% reduced depletion on skilling nodes
*Ice walking boots
*7% damage boost
*Increased chance of slayer creature spawns
*1 puzzle room skip per party per floor
*7% discount on rewards shop and floor prestiging
*Improved chance of not using a lock melter
*+3 stat boost
Sinkholes:
*3 additional teleports a day
*10% extra XP from lamps

Travel to islands and archipelagos toward the Eastern Lands, visiting The Arc and many other places along the way. Search for buried treasure and seek out new prizes and rewards including level 70 augmentable armour and weapons!

It's time for a festival! Win Harvest Festival seeds on Treasure Hunter which can be planted anywhere and will quickly reach full growth. Once grown, pick the produce and offer it up for Farming or Prayer XP.

Share the festive spirit by helping prune the rotten produce from other players plants and burn it for Firemaking XP!

Collect the all new Sunfury cosmetic outfit, including cape and shield! Skilling in Divination will occasionally award you with Solar Flares, which are also available from Treasure Hunter chests - combine these Solar Flares to create pieces of the Sunfury Armour, and collect the set. But it doesn't stop there - train Prayer while wearing the armour, and unlock an upgraded version of the set. The Sunfury outfit can be activated from the Wardrobe interface once unlocked.

Take on the challenge of the Zombie to complete a variety of tasks and challenges. Once you have completed a row you will be rewarded with prizes including stars and lamps. Complete a column, and you will be rewarded with the flesh of the infected - a zombie themed outfit piece. Complete the entire card and you will earn the ability to prestige, unlocking unique gruesome weapons and animations, and unlock the ability to get more decayed versions of the infected flesh. Win Brain Stickers on Treasure Hunter to instantly finish tasks, and be sure to be on the lookout for Zrik, the living dead, lurking in Gielinor.

The advent calendar is back! For 25 days your favourite promotions old and new will be reappearing on Treasure Hunter. Check back every day to find what prizes are available to win, from Skill Outfits to Lamps of all varieties, Protean items to Dragon Chests, Bonus Boosters and Rainbow's end. On top of that, open your advent calendar every day for a free gift relating to that day's promotion!

The newest addition to the protean range. Manufacture protean cogs anywhere in the world to earn yourself some experience. Don't have access to the Invention skill? You can also win protean packs so stock up today on all your protean materials!

Party Pete has decided to change his ways after the New Year Celebrations. Keep your New Years Resolutions, complete the rows and you'll be rewarded with prizes including prismatic stars and lamps. Complete the columns, and you'll be rewarded with Party Pete's Disco, Cool Disco and Super Disco outfits, the latter of which can be recoloured! Complete the entire list and you will earn the ability to prestige, unlocking some unique dance emotes and a conga walk override. Win Gold Star Stickers on Treasure Hunter to instantly finish off the New Year Resolutions or use them like prismatic lamps after completing the event!

The all new elite Woodcutting skilling outfit! Collect these outfit pieces and unlock some almighty woodcutting benefits, including increased success rate when woodcutting, increased chance of birds nests, teleports to tree locations and a chance to automatically burn logs when skilling. Combine all the outfits into the Nature's Sentinel outfit to get even higher success rates, more teleports, burn and fletch chances, ability to plant a miniature evil tree and even more!

Hydra Lamps can grant you two wishes! Rub the Hydra Lamps and select 2 skills that you already have Bonus XP in - Like a smouldering lamp, they will instantly burn up the same amount of bonus XP as it would give normally, allowing you to benefit from the XP immediately! They can still be used on skills with no bonus XP, but to get the most from them, you'll want to burn through some of that stocked up bonus XP!

Now with 6 Boosters! Choose when to activate the buttons on Treasure Hunter's interface and tailor the experience to what you need! After activating one of the boosters, it has a small cooldown time before you can use it again but you'll be able to use the others while one is cooling off!
The boosters are:
- Lucky Purple Booster - Ensure your next prize is a purple!
- Multiplier Booster - Randomly boost the number of prizes the next few chests give you!
- Extrasensory Booster - Look inside the chests for gem rarity before selecting your prize!
- Smouldering Booster - All lamps and stars will become Smouldering hot for a number of chests!
- Upgrade Booster - Upgrades the rarity of all prizes by one!
- Deep Freeze Booster - Allows an additional 5 prizes to be frozen with hearts of ice!

It's Valentine's again. Help Wizard Deedit fix his unfortunate mistake in Lumbridge Crater for special devotion themed rewards. The unfortunate Wizard requires adventurers with expertise in Mining, Smithing, Herblore, Hunter, Magic and Invention. Win Counteragent on Treasure Hunter to increase your skilling proficiency while helping out at the crater.

It's time to begin preparations for the Spring Fayre! Locate Menowin near the lumbridge crater to help build a helter skelter and get it ready for people to ride. Work as a community to complete the necessary tasks and unlock rewards together, including a mysterious staff. Ran out of tools for the job? Earn more through opening Treasure Hunter chests during the event, or speak to Menowin to buy more with Loyalty Points!

Collect the all new Lunarfury cosmetic outfit, including cape and weapons! Skilling in Runecrafting will occasionally award you with Lunar Spheres, which are also available from Treasure Hunter chests - combine these Lunar Spheres to create pieces of the Lunarfury Armour, and collect the set. But it doesn't stop there - train Runecrafting or Mining while wearing the armour, and unlock an upgraded version of the set. The Lunarfury outfit can be activated from the Wardrobe interface once unlocked.

Brand new chests to be dug up during this promotion! Take the hunt into your own hands as you dig around our new maps in search for prizes. Dig up usual rewards, but also 6 chests:
- Cosmetic Chests for a chance at cosmetics from days gone by!
- Animation Chests for a chance at animation tokens!
- Experience Chests for an abundance of lamps, stars and the like
- Skilling Chests for items that help you train
- Protean Chests for all your protean needs
- Antique Chests for a chance at some old Treasure Hunter rewards
There are also two unique items to win as well - the Treasure Resting Emote and the Treasure Map item to hold!

Open chests to get your hands on these relics, and then smash them to the ground to find out what hides within! You can get your hands on cash bags, prismatic lamps and more - however these relics also include prizes from events past, such as the Dragon Ceremonial and Queen's Guard armours!

There's a phenomenon in the skies - a collection of Supernovae! Collect Supreme Stars throughout this event, and you'll be rewarded. These stars replace many lamps and stars, awarding double the amount of bonus XP usual stars give out. Stock up now and be prepared for all your adventures ahead!

New purples are in! The purple prizes on treasure hunter have been refreshed and the rare item store has been shaken up. Keep an eye out for the brand new lucky barrows sets on treasure hunter, as well as funky items like Springy the sentient spring pet, floating balloons that allow relaxation by air, the bad weather umbrella and more! Find Rare item tokens from treasure hunter and grab your favourite!
There are a limited number of discounted new rares to get your hands on. Get them before they return to their normal price, and also be sure to grab any 'Limited Rares' before they disappear from the store.

Dune fractures have started opening up all over the world - and your help is needed to close them! Find the large fracture north of the Lumbridge Crater, or hunt all over the land to find other fractures as they appear. Use Dune Menders found in chests to close dunes after you've hit your daily limit whilst earning increased experience!

Welcome to Prize Pool, where every key can give you two prizes! Open a chest and claim via the prize pool at the top to get an extra prize, or alternatively risk it by opening more chests to increase the rarity of the rewards! When you're ready, hit claim to take all the prizes lit up, but be careful - at any point your next key might lose all of those extra prizes!

When opening chests, as well as your normal prize you will also be awarded with Oddments. These can be exchanged for various prizes, including more Treasure Hunter keys! But that's not all! All lamps and stars have been replaced with their prismatic counterparts for the duration of the event.

It's apple season!
You can win modified apples on Treasure Hunter which can be used on one of the special Jubilee hoppers placed around the world, by Wizard Deedit, to give Invention XP, Farming XP or a mixture of both.
The hoppers can also be used to give improved experience from protean cogs, which are also available to win during this event in additional slots.

These elite trapper outfits are perfect for that advanced training. When you complete one of the 3 base sets, you'll have the following Hunter benefits:
*5% increase to hunting success rate
*Auto-reapplies Juju hunter potion in Herblore Habitat
*Increased chance of rarer charm sprites from Yaktwee
*3 daily teleports to hunter locations
Complete the high tier outfit by combining all of the low tier pieces, to get the following benefits:
*7% increase to hunting success rate
*10% chance of double loot
*Can deploy an extra trap (max 6)
*Increased conversion rate for Big Chinchompa reward points
*Chance to instantly deploy/pickup traps
*Chance of double loot from implings (3/day)
*Works as a hunter's catalyst fragment if owned
*Auto-reapplies Juju hunter potion in Herblore Habitat
*Increased chance of rarer charm sprites from Yaktwee
*5 daily teleports to hunter locations

A mystical glow has taken over Treasure Hunter, and your prize line-up has been enhanced! Enjoy a minimum of all yellow prizes on the prize ticker, and keep opening chests for a chance at all oranges plus, or even all red prizes plus!

Check back regularly as the promotions will be switching throughout the day!
Look out for Smouldering Lamps, Rainbow's End, Prismania, Celebration Lamps, Dragon Chests and Loot Duels!

The mysterious <col=1e88e5>Ghostweave</col> has returned to Treasure Hunter, and can be shaped into ghostly outfits - new and old! Remake the costumes from years ago or create the new apparel. Or, convert your <col=1e88e5>Ghostweave</col> into various chocolates for your choice of 7 spooky effects. Spare <col=1e88e5>ghostweave</col> can be converted into crafting XP or gold once all outfits are made, or after the promotion ends.

It's time to join the assassins! Complete the Assassin's Contract in your inventory to unlock brand new Faceless Assassin outfits and weapon overrides. Win task skips on Treasure Hunter to speed up completing the set. Finish the 16 tasks up to 5 times to unlock new colour options and a sweet assassin walk override!

The Ocean's Archer cosmetic attire and weapons are available to win on Treasure Hunter with increased chances whilst the promotion is active! They can be unlocked via tradeable tokens, and you can swap with your friends or buy them to complete the set. The Tokens continue to be available after this promotion but will increase in rarity.

The Cavern of Tainted Memories has been opened, and holds treasures aplenty to be claimed. Enter the cavern via the portal in Burthorpe for free once a day or use a cavern entry ticket which can be won from Treasure Hunter. You'll have a limited time to claim as much essence as you can! Essence can be spent on forging the new Purified Weaponry and can also be gathered with your normal wisp training. Don't want Divination XP? Talk to Kristlin to earn mystery rewards instead!

Some mysterious tomes have been discovered. These tomes can grant the reader a rather intriguing amount of experience depending on their contents in your chosen skill. Break the spine and open them to literally reveal the chaos inside!</col>

The Equinox has hit Gielinor and Solite and Lunite sigils have been scattered around the world and on Treasure Hunter. Find sigils as you train, depending on your attunement which changes automatically every 3 hours. Not happy with the current attunement? You can right-click a sigil to change attunement and receive the sigil type of your choice (manual attunement limited to once every 3 hours). Combine enough Solite or Lunite sigils to create the two new armours and weapons.

Gemporium has come to Treasure Hunter! There's a chance of rarity boosts and multiplier boosts on each key you use. Rarity boost guarantee your prizes are of a certain rarity or higher - yellow, orange or red. Multiplier boosts give you prizes in multiples - double, triple or quadruple. Best of all, both boosts can activate at the same time!

The Tribal Trials are open, with tests of strength and mettle waiting. Complete the tasks in rows and columns on your Tribal task list to receive your prizes! Once you've completed all 16 tasks on your list you'll get a bonus prize, plus you can then start again to win more rewards! Win Tribal Mask stamps from Treasure Hunter and use them to skip any tasks you don't want to complete, quickly marking them as done. If you find the tiny tribal creature, he will also give you 2 stamps for free once per list! Once the Tribal Trials are complete, any spare Tribal Mask stamps can be used as small prismatic lamps.

New stars have appeared on Treasure Hunter, and this time they're bursting with Bonus XP - so much so that they're a little unstable! Win stars from Treasure Hunter and choose a pre-selected category of skills to use your star on. One skill in this category will receive a large chunk of bonus XP, while the rest will receive a little bonus XP in all of them. More bonus XP spread across more skills - what more could you want?

Treasure Hunter has turned into a boneyard - with new abilities and prizes! Search in a square for treasure and you may find another square revealed to you - either by a skill icon denoting the prize hidden in that square, or an icon revealing a category prize! Win fab prizes like the new Bone Master outfit or Skeletal bear pet!
Choose any skill, the randomly boosted skill, or chain together skills in a column, corner or row for increased rewards in XP or Bonus XP from your Locks or Chains!

The Ocean's Warrior and Ocean's Mage outfits and weapons are available to win on Treasure Hunter with increased chances whilst the promotion is active! You can now choose which outfit pieces and weapons you unlock by using an Ocean Token! There are also new Ocean Mystery Boxes up for grabs which are packed with a variety of lamps and stars. If you're not interested in the cosmetics you can use your Ocean Tokens to claim Ocean Mystery Boxes too!

Win these Summer Piñatas from Treasure Hunter, hang them up and go crazy in order to win awesome prizes - catch everything that comes out and you can get anything from stat boosting sweets to the all new Hydro Suit and Tidal Weapons. You are not limited to your own Piñata though! Feel free to take a swing at a friend's piñata too, and see what you can bag.

Find all-new lamp chests on Treasure Hunter. Each Chest contains five items - a prismatic lamp, smouldering lamp, lava lantern, celebration lamp and hydra lamp!
If you're lucky enough you might find Cratos, the crab pet hiding inside one of the chests. Find them now and get training!
The power of the gems is locked away, open them and reap the rewards!
Use Treasure Hunter keys and win rewards! Keys can be purchased or earned through completing quests and playing the game. You will also be given free daily keys every day!

Use Treasure Hunter Keys to unlock the gems and find out what is inside. Each set of gems will contain 1 <col=0xFFFF00>Shadow Gem</col> which will award <col=0xFFFF00>Pestilent Gem Shards</col> which can be exchanged for unique rewards.

The Skilling Backpack makes a return, and can gain you XP boosts and useful items. Wear the backpack while training to receive a temporary XP boost of 5%, which will stack during the upcoming Double XP Weekend. Plus, attune your backpack to get preferred item drops, like proteans or things that help you when skilling. Win powerpacks from Treasure Hunter to charge up your backpack and use it for longer! Note that at 2, 5, 15 and 30 keys used, you are guaranteed to receive extra charges for your backpack as an additional prize!

The doctor is in the house, with tests of strength and mettle waiting. Complete the tasks in rows and columns on your Plague doctor task list to receive your prizes! Once you've completed all 16 tasks on your list you'll get a bonus prize, plus you can then start again to win more rewards! Win Plague Doctor stamps from Treasure Hunter and use them to skip any tasks you don't want to complete, quickly marking them as done. If you find the Plague Doctor he will also give you 2 stamps for free once during the event! Once the Plague doctor trials are complete, any spare Plague Doctor stamps can be used as small prismatic lamps.

The advent calendar is back! For 25 days your favourite promotions old and new will be reappearing on Treasure Hunter. Check back every day to find what prizes are available to win, from Loot Duels to Dragon Chests, Bonus Boosters and Rainbow's end. On top of that, open your advent calendar every day for a free gift relating to that day's promotion!
Slime is of the essence, November 2018

The King Slime has arisen, spreading goo and terror in Rimmington! This is how Peter, the Cook, knew he messed up. Ask Peter what happened and how to repel this menacing monstrosity! Use different skills each day for slick rewards. Ran out of tools? Win more from Treasure Hunter or buy them with Loyalty Points from Peter.

Dive down deep for sunken treasure. These sunken chests contain the all new Bubbling Lamps which let you pick whether you want to use them for direct XP or bonus XP. On top of that, there's a chance that all your chests will become gilded - giving you 4x prizes!

Looking for bonus XP? Well, all-new Glitter Bombs are here to brighten up your day. These sparkling items give you bonus XP in the skill of your choice, plus a smaller explosion of bonus XP in ALL other skills. Now's the perfect time to shine a little light on your less trained skills.

It's time to delve deep into The Undergrowth. While digging through the dense vegetation you may uncover a powerup elsewhere in the grid - this could be anything up to a 4x muliplier or even a guaranteed purple prize! Keep your eye out for brand new tokens which can be exchanged for the Bloodtusk Warlord armour and Squeaker axe!

The Voice of Seren is echoing throughout Gielinor! The prizes in chests change with Seren's voice, matching the effects she is casting over the world. Increase your XP gains during the weekend, and check back for changes on Treasure Hunter with each new voice.

The celestial bodies have aligned, and the energy is being channeled into lanterns! Collect two unique types of lantern: Dawn lanterns, which give increased XP and bonus XP if you choose one of your lowest skills, and Dusk lanterns, which give increased XP and bonus XP if you choose one of your highest skills.

Traders from Rei Ti have brought a unique set of fire-themed armour to the mainland. Increase your chance of getting the armour piece you want by selecting it on Treasure Hunter before opening a chest. If you prefer XP, you can select the lamp option for a chance of getting Bubbling, Phoenix and Smouldering lamps.

The cat is back! Claim Felix for free and open chests to collect his new Sameowrai armour set. Finding the full set will unlock bonus fur colours. You can also fill the prize bar for a guaranteed piece of pet armour on your next chest!

There's an active volcano on the horizon! Open chests to find volcanic lamps which auto-redeem some of your Bonus XP.

Bonus Feature: While opening chests there's a chance for the volcano to erupt. When the volcano is erupting, all volcanic lamps will be replaced with erupting lamps which grant 100% extra XP compared to a volcanic lamp!

The advent calendar is back! For 24 days your favourite promotions old and new will be reappearing on Treasure Hunter. Check back every day to find what prizes are available to win, from Dragon's Dozen to Dragon Chests, Cerberus Frost and Rainbow's End. On top of that, open your advent calendar every day for a free gift relating to that day's promotion!

Cinder Cores - get your hands on these powerful cores that grant double bonus XP burn while active. On top of that, you'll pulse out an anima power that empowers everyone beside you as well! Each time a core pulses, you'll give those around you a 2% Bonus XP burn boost, which stacks up to 10%! Use them in populated skilling areas to ensure everyone gets the most out of their gains!

All the prizes that you will be winning are visible to you! Don't like the prizes on offer? Spend oddments to refresh the collection at any time! <col=009933>There is an equal chance of winning all visible prizes!
Pick a crystal and choose one of five prizes of that rarity! You can spend oddments to re-roll these prizes up to three times, with a chance of upgrading the rarity to the next level as well!

Goo would think it? - A slime has taken over Treasure Hunter! Feed it Hearts of Ice to increase the probabilities of winning rarer prizes! Also, feed it keys to both increase your slay multiplier and to receive a prize. Once you are content with your goopy creation, slay it and release that juicy multiplier. Slime flies when you're having fun, doesn't it?

Modify your prizes using dwarven invention techniques! You can add extra prizes, increase the rarity of your prize or even multiply the amount you get! You also have a chance to win dwarven toolboxes, which can be used to create a dwarven tool of your choice, including the new Dwarven harvester!
Modifiers have different chances of appearing:
White - 43.5%
Yellow - 30%
Orange - 20%
Red - 5%
Purple - 1.5%

It's time to unearth the past and uncover three new rewards that aid with Archaeology training! While excavating you may uncover a powerup elsewhere in the grid - this could be anything up to a 4x muliplier or even a guaranteed purple prize! Keep an eye out for restored artefact replicators, dwarven excavators and fixate charge tokens, which will aid you in your archaeological exploits!

Collect crystals in horizontal and diagonal lines to unlock bonus prizes. Every crystal you unlock also earns you progress to bonus rewards! After you've earnt enough progress you'll also prestige the track, unlocking access to even better bonus rewards!

In Gifts on the Creators, it's your choice! Will you go for the lamp? Or maybe you've craving some Bonus XP and opt for the star? If neither take your fancy, choose the Wild Card and see what the Creators have in store for you!
Make progress to <col=0xF0BE79>extra rewards</col> with every key you use. There is even a chance at receiving <col=0xF0BE79>50 million coins</col>!
The harvest is upon us! Smash Pumpkins for H'oddments and more!

Smash pumpkins to receive H'oddments and more whilst filling the Harvest Bonus bar. When the bar is filled, choose between a pumpkin modifier or reward item.
H'oddments can be exchanged for unique rewards in the H'oddments store for the duration of the promotion and 7 days afterwards.

When you failed, I had no choice.
I needed the children to survive.
I took them to Freneskae. I thought we would be safe there.
Jas found us. There was nothing we could to do stop her reclaiming the eggs.
She could kill us all with merely a word.

No power in this universe could stand in her way.
I did not expect you to find it in another.
The shadow leviathan struck without warning.
I felt its presence tear into our reality.
It was Kerapac that broke the balance.

Heedless of the terrible pain his defiance earned him,
he directed the full force of his artefacts towards their creator.
Its power spent, the Needle broke.
The monstrous intruder dragged its prey back into its own realm.
Without the Needle, Kerapac was powerless to avoid the same fate.
Its hunger satisfied, the breach snapped shut, leaving in its place a terrible silence.
Jas was the greatest of us all. Irreplaceable.
Her loss forced me to accept something.
Your survival depends on our deaths.
So you see, I had no choice.
For my family to survive, a world had to die.
They reached down from the sky, the hands of creation itself, to birth their waiting children.

As they touched the eggs, memories passed from one generation to the next.
Aeons of identity, stretching back through time.

As the lifeless bodies of the adults fell, the power of the newborn children drained all life from the planet.
All life.
The children. My family. At last, they live.
They know me. They love me. They spared me.
They have fulfilled their birthright. All other life on Iaia is gone.

My life has been long, and throughout it I have lived by one maxim:
Survival forced my people to become the greatest of warriors.
When the stranger promised us conquest and plenty, we followed him.
On Gielinor, I built a mighty empire in the name of the dark god Zaros.
But he and I did not share the same vision for the future.
Where I saw freedom, he saw only control.
My people, once warriors, became priests.
To win their freedom, I struck down a god.
To safeguard it, I became one.
On Infernus, I led a downtrodden people to victory.
Hostilius, a corpulent monster grown fat and indolent, maintained order through rules and laws.
His laws did as little to protect him as his skin did.
I strung up his corpse as a message for all to see. Such is the fate of all tyrants.
The Avernic demons, now free, serve me willingly.
Back on Gielinor, pretenders picked over the remains of my empire.
For an age I battled them.
An age of strife, of progress, of glory.
While I fought on, none could establish the safety, the security, that they so craved.
For an age, Gielinor was truly free.
But they conspired against me, and I was banished.
In my long absence, this world has become weak.
Saradomin's fingers are wrapped tightly around its throat, suffocating it.
My demon army will make short work of its farmers, woodcutters and fishermen.
The survivors will be stronger. They will have no choice.
Gielinor's people will be free, or they will die.

I am soon to be crowned. It is a burden that I do not take lightly.
As Basilissa, it is my duty to see that the kingdoms are protected.
Right now, there is one looming threat that haunts me; that threatens us all.
The Civil War is over. Bilrach won.
The demons, defeated, fell in line and joined the ranks of his army.
Bilrach is in a position to launch a full-scale invasion.
But it is not enough. The powerful always crave more power.
He greedily seeks more ways to expand his influence and cement his dominance.
Even now, he gathers his forces and spreads out across the world in search of something.
Whatever he is trying to do, it represents a terrible threat to the rest of the world.
We must stop him. We must put an end to his reign, before it begins.
Bilrach didn't think to inspect the marker before his ritual, and it cost him dearly.
He sought the power he felt was owed to him.
He dreamed of draining souls from across the world, becoming unrivalled in his power.
In a world without gods, he would rule without opposition.
Unrivalled. Untouchable. But it was not to be.
Your sabotage turned the power Bilrach summoned into the marker against itself.
Magic surged until the structure could contain it no longer.
In a great thunderclap, the marker exploded, shattering across the Wilderness like a bad dream.
The power contained returned to the dirt and the soil. The shards of soul it harnessed returned to the underworld to await their afterlife.
Bilrach had failed. His plan ruined. His dreams of glory shattered like the marker.
In one act of sabotage, the world was safe once more. None even knew they'd been at risk.
Bilrach's army remained. It was still a threat. Still a terrible danger.
But the infallibility of his leadership was gone; his authority lost, like his dreams of dominion.

This book - the Glacienomicom, aka the Book of Ice - details Orcus's discovery of the existence of Rasial and his exploits in the west. It also has a treatise on using animated skeletons as a defensive wall of bone.

This book - the Fumonomicom, aka the Book of Smoke - details how Orcus learned that Rasial used to be a guardian of magic and runes. It also has a treatise on shrouding oneself with ghosts, making it harder for enemies to target you.

This book - the Umbranomicom, aka the Book of Shadow - details Orcus's revelation that Rasial was a once-human follower of Guthix. It also has a treatise on using a phantom - the Spirit of Death - to make enemies easier to kill.

This book - the Sanguinomicom, aka the Book of Blood - details how Orcus tasked the Hereditas Expedition to track down the location of the tomb of Rasial. It also has a treatise on transferring one's own life essence to prolong zombie minions.
Orcus's collected writings on necromancy, and Gielinor's first necromancer.

Every day you are assigned 3 random challenges, replacing any incomplete or unclaimed challenges.
Once you have started a challenge, you can track your progress here.
The Track button adds the challenge to your activity tracker.

To celebrate your return to Gielinor, you can earn unique rewards by completing special returner challenges.
Completing these challenges fills the progress bar, which unlocks new rewards for every three challenges you complete.
At the end of the day, you will receive new challenges. However, you will keep any challenges that haven't been completed, so you can take your time with more difficult tasks.
Stuck on a challenge? Complete it instantly if you have a challenge token. You can earn these from progress reward chests.

A new threat rises! Defend Fort Forinthry in the ultimate last stand against Vorkath, Zemouregal and his army of minions in this new quest.

Take part in a new multi-phase boss battle to earn exciting new rewards, including the new upgradeable Dracolich armour.

Quest requirements:
- Complete 'Ancient Awakening' quest
- Level 60 Necromancy
- Woodcutter's Grove Tier 1
- Botanist's Bench Tier 1

Mr. Mordaut needs your help. Collect Vorkath Shards by completing tasks and fending off Zemouregal and Vorkath.

Combine eight of these shards to unlock exclusive Necromancy weapon cosmetic overrides and temporary buffs, such as the return of the infinite porter!

Embark on an all-new seasonal adventure. Join Santa and his trusty snow imps to spread holiday cheer throughout Gielinor.

Journey to the Christmas Village in the Land of Snow and discover fresh Christmas activities, new seasonal quest, classic and new holiday rewards, and more!

Deliver letters to Santa to get your place on the Nice List to earn special weekly presents.

Old favourites return with the Advent Calendar and Wrapping Paper.

We're looking for your feedback in our Combat beta!

Get involved and experiment with changes we've made to the original combat styles to bring them up to modern standards.
Check out some of the proposed changes below!

- Enable 'Damage Potential' for all combat styles for the player.
- Increase the 'Damage Cap' for all combat styles (from 10,000/12,000 to 30,000).
- Implement a simplified Critical Strike system for all combat styles.

Experience a flurry of quality of life updates throughout the festive period, featuring some of the most requested changes suggested by you, the players.

Look out for some highly anticipated Game Jam projects also making their way to Gielinor.

Watch as major parts of Gielinor receive a new lick of paint in a series of graphical updates including locations such as Entrana and various dungeons!

Look forward to further environmental refreshes in the future, starting with Kandarin in early 2024.

Check out new updates to our tech!

Experience RuneScape with richer colours, thanks to new specular lighting updates, features such as improved interface and game resolution scaling, and more!

Each Relic tier contains a choice of Relics, all with unique powers.

Once you've gained enough points to unlock a Relic tier, you can choose any Relic from within it.

Selecting a Relic will bring up the Relic information panel.

From there, you can view information on that Relic. If you have a relic choice available you may also choose to unlock it from the information panel.

You may only choose one Relic per tier and the choice can not be reversed once confirmed. Certain relics may also allow you to choose from a previous tier, so it's also worth looking at relics you can not yet claim to plan ahead!
It is highly recommended to look at every relic closely!

As well as unlocking a powerful relic, you will also unlock passive effects such as XP multipliers.

It's always worth unlocking a relic as soon as you can!

You must be in a <col=FFCB05>party</col> to start Dungeoneering. You can be in a party by <col=FFCB05>yourself</col>, or with up to <col=FFCB05>four other players</col>.

The player who created the party is the <col=FFCB05>party leader</col>. The party leader can <col=FFCB05>choose which dungeon floor</col> to do next, as well as the <col=FFCB05>complexity</col> and <col=FFCB05>size</col> of the dungeon.

When you first start Dungeoneering, only <col=FFCB05>floor 1</col> will be unlocked. You must <col=FFCB05>complete a floor</col> before you can unlock the next one, and you may only <col=FFCB05>access a floor</col> if you have the <col=FFCB05>necessary Dungeoneering level</col>.

All members of your party must have the <col=FFCB05>floor unlocked</col> for you to delve into it. To see which floors are unlocked by all players, look at the columns that run vertically down the screen to the left - there's a <col=FFCB05>column for each member of your group</col>.
Upon completing a floor for the first time each run, you'll receive a <col=FFCB05>floor buff</col> that will <col=FFCB05>boost various aspects of Daemonheim</col>.

The buff you receive <col=FFCB05>cycles through the listed buffs in order</col> - the <col=FFCB05>next buff you'll receive is highlighted</col>. These buffs will <col=FFCB05>automatically reset</col> once you've <col=FFCB05>completed the number of floors available to you</col>.

The <col=FFCB05>complexity</col> of a dungeon determines <col=FFCB05>how many of your skills and abilities</col> will be tested. Choosing <col=FFCB05>low complexity</col> will make the dungeon more <col=FFCB05>straightforward</col> to complete, but it will also <col=FFCB05>lower the Dungeoneering XP</col> you receive at the end.

When you first start Dungeoneering, only low complexity will be unlocked. You must <col=FFCB05>complete at least one dungeon</col> on low complexity before you can <col=FFCB05>unlock high complexity</col>.
<col=FFCB05>Equipment</col> and <col=FFCB05>potions</col> you find or make in the dungeon can be <col=FFCB05>bound to you</col> by <col=FFCB05>right-clicking 'Bind'</col> on them.
Binding an item to yourself means the <col=FFCB05>item is available to use on any floor</col>. You can <col=FFCB05>unbind items by destroying them</col>.

You can view and manage your bound items here. Loadouts allow you to <col=FFCB05>decide which equipment you start a dungeon with</col>, and can be set up by <col=FFCB05>dragging a bound item over to a loadout slot</col>. As you level up Dungeoneering, you'll <col=FFCB05>unlock more loadout slots</col>.
You can <col=FFCB05>store items</col> you find in the dungeon here, and access them on any floor. As you level up Dungeoneering, you'll <col=FFCB05>unlock more storage slots</col>.

The Nakkirian people used lunar cycles to track time. Their dates were recorded as the current lunar phase, current lunar cycle, and current epoch. An epoch spanned a hundred lunar cycles.
This statue appears to depict a common wolf, rather than reflecting the likeness of the Nakkirian wolf-god. It seems that all wolves were considered sacred to the people of Moonrise.
These ceremonial sickles were worn by priests and priestesses of Dilimbabbar, Lord of Cycles. They represented his domain over harvests and the turning of the seasons.
A cylinder seal depicting the likeness of Kayazu, Lord of Ceremonies. It was used to roll an impression onto soft clay tablets, to notarize them as official documents.

A popular board game in which players competed to move their tokens from one end of the board to the other, while avoiding capture. A set of Ivory beads excavated nearby suggests wagering was often involved.

Also known as a belt loom. One end was attached to a fixed object, and the other to the weaver's back using a leather belt. The weaver would then lean back, using their body weight to apply tension to the loom.

Woven animal dolls of all species were popular among the Nakkirian people, often adorned with intricate details carved from ivory. A small engraving on this one's ear indicates that he was named 'Shuruk-baaaaa'.
A woollen mantle worn by members of the temple. They were woven in a tufted pattern that gave the impression of overlapping petals or feathers.
These vessels, used to burn incense, can be found throughout the temple of Akshur-Nakkir. Various fragrances were used, depending on the current lunar phase and what rituals were taking place.
The Nakkirian people believed that the presentation of offerings to their gods was of great importance, which lead to these bowls becoming increasingly vibrant and beautifully decorated.

A mixture of fermented grape juice and colossi blood, diluted with the blood of common animals. It granted the drinker great strength and vitality and was believed to bestow bestial features when concentrated.
These jars were used to store herbs, flowers and other regents used in the brewing bloodwine and powerful blood-based elixirs.
A mural painted on a slab of stone. It depicts Ninbaradari, the Chimera Queen, gifting the blood of the colossi to her adherents.
A jagged dagger, carved from pure stone. There are lingering traces of incredibly potent blood magic upon it, despite the millennia that have passed since it's last use.
These fangs were gouged out of the maw of Kayazu, Lord of Ceremonies, prior to his demise. They were awarded to the highest-ranking members of the Chimera Queen's court, as a symbol of high status.

This is the blessing selection menu.

Each blessing tier contains a choice of blessings, all with unique powers.

Once you've completed enough blessing tasks to unlock a blessing tier, you can choose any blessing from within it.

Blessings offer powerful combat effects.

There are 3 types of Blessings - Chaos, Balance and Order.

Your choices define your path ahead.

The God Blessing you can unlock is determined by the choices you make in previous tiers.

Your most favoured path will determine which blessing becomes available:

Lean heavily towards Chaos to unlock the Chaos God Blessing.
Follow a balanced path to unlock the Balance God Blessing.
Lean heavily towards Order to unlock the Order God Blessing.

Selecting a blessing will bring up the blessing information panel.

From there, you can view information on that blessing. If you have a blessing choice available you may also choose to unlock it from the information panel.

You may choose only one blessing per tier.

You can reset your choices a limited number of times. You begin with 1 reset point and gain 1 additional reset point each time you unlock a God Blessing.
It is highly recommended to look at every blessing closely!
